subject.title: Isolated cron consistently fails with "LLM request failed" on model-call-started phase

question: Should #91363 remain the umbrella for isolated-cron model-call and `LLM request failed` cascades, or should the remaining work be split to narrower trackers after the main-only fixes?
rationale: The central behavior is partly fixed on main, but open and recent reports still span multiple runtime boundaries, and the latest requested session reset after consecutive errors is a product policy choice rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Use #91363 to hold cross-provider isolated-cron failure evidence until a current-main live repro/verification pass proves which narrower trackers remain.

options.title: Split Remaining Subpaths
options.body: Move the remaining watchdog, stream-progress, fallback-idle, and session-reset questions to existing narrower issues and close this only after each link is explicit.

options.title: Close After Release Verification
options.body: Wait for a release containing #94062 and #96096, then close only if affected users or maintainer proof show the broad cascade no longer reproduces.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Use #91363 to hold cross-provider isolated-cron failure evidence until a current-main live repro/verification pass proves which narrower trackers remain.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses cron watchdog, fallback, and provider-runtime ownership, where steipete has relevant recent feature-history commits and is the best routing candidate from the sampled history.
